notice: Proposed related control references for a fictional vendor ITGC exercise. References are not equivalence claims or evidence of framework conformity.

controls.title: Vendor workforce access revocation
controls.objective: Access for terminated vendor personnel is revoked by termination and no later login is recorded.
controls.owner: Vendor identity and access owner (fictional role)
questions: Are vendor-user access grants inventoried by service?
Does offboarding remove access by termination?
Does available authentication evidence show any later access?
expected_evidence: Named user and service access list
Relevant last-authentication event, scoped to the assessed service
controls.mapping_note: Related references for access rights management and privileged access.

controls.title: Vendor production change authorization
controls.objective: Production changes have an accountable approver and approval before deployment.
questions: Can each deployed production change be traced to a record?
Are emergency changes subject to retrospective review under a defined process?
controls.mapping_note: Related references for configuration and change management; this check tests sample approval sequence only.

controls.title: Vendor backup completion and restore evidence
controls.objective: Scheduled backup jobs complete and defined restore-test evidence is recorded.
questions: Did the scheduled backup complete within the required window?
Is there evidence of a restore test for the stated service or data scope?
Does the evidence describe a test result and date?
expected_evidence: Exception owner and remediation record for a failure
controls.mapping_note: Related references for backup and ICT resilience; these small fixtures do not measure recoverability or RTO/RPO attainment.
